name: Pulissery
steps: Cut mango into large pieces and simmer with turmeric, half the water and salt for 8–10 minutes until tender.
Grind coconut, green chillies and cumin with remaining water into a fine paste; whisk yogurt smooth.
Add coconut paste to mango and simmer 4 minutes. Reduce heat and stir in yogurt; warm gently for 2–3 minutes without boiling.
Heat coconut oil and crackle mustard seeds, dried red chillies and curry leaves. Pour over the curry and rest 5 minutes before serving.
tips: Use sweet ripe mango to balance the lightly sour yogurt; do not let yogurt boil.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
